**HORMUZ — the ledger admits it is a floor; CENTCOM denies the mine claims.** (a) UKMTO admitted Oct-16 it is 'struggling to accurately report the true number of attacks' — the majority of targeted vessels no longer report; 12 confirmed attacks week-ending Oct-16 (10 inside the strait; 1 vessel lost, 2 disabled, 3 unconfirmed) is now officially a FLOOR. All ledger-tempo signals carry a declared downward bias from here. (b) The IRGC mine claim escalated to TWO laden tankers (IRNA) — and drew an on-record denial: a CENTCOM spokesman says the mine claims are FALSE (Newsquawk); JMIC separately states there is NO substantiation. Claimed-vs-confirmed gap now has official weight on the deny side; still no UKMTO incident number for any mine strike. Adjudication open, leaning structural venue difference; direct CME retrieval remains the owed check. 10Y 5.117 (11.7bp cushion). Blackout runs to Oct 27-28; September PCE Oct-29; midterms Nov-3 — 14 days.

**ALPENGLOW T-0 — migration executes TODAY.** Epoch 1064 start ~13:20 UTC (Solana Foundation) / feature-gate activation ~14:50-15:00 UTC (Anza/QuickNode window); feature gate A1pengvuM6JEcyNuTnMqepBKhwHE3N6PmUrdATGawhJS. FAIL-SAFE: if 82% never signs, there is NO abort step and no intermediate state — the chain simply continues on TowerBFT; worst case is non-migration, not a halt. Verify via getAgGenesisCert non-null on a 4.3+ node. Also newly surfaced: Solana's slot-time cut 400ms -> 200ms completed across four stages in October — a second, already-landed structural break for latency-sensitive series. **Data-path check:** Binance 33rd check — DISCONNECTED for the THIRD consecutive cycle: (BTCUSDT,SOLUSDT,ETHUSDT) returned EMPTY_DATA, all symbol queries failed.
